+use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
+#[command(
+    name = "tracehurl",
+    version,
+    about = "Evidence-first verification report generator for Hurl and test suites"
+)]
+pub struct Cli {
+    #[command(subcommand)]
+    pub command: Commands,
+}
+
+#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
+pub enum Commands {
+    /// Generate an evidence-first interactive HTML report and machine-readable JSON model
+    Report {
+        /// Path to the verification run directory
+        run_dir: PathBuf,
+
+        /// Output directory for generated report (default: <run-dir>/report)
+        #[arg(short, long)]
+        output: Option<PathBuf>,
+
+        /// Open the report in default web browser upon generation
+        #[arg(long)]
+        open: bool,
+    },
+
+    /// Inspect phases, scenarios, entries, captures, and diagnostics without generating HTML
+    Inspect {
+        /// Path to the verification run directory
+        run_dir: PathBuf,
+
+        /// Print detailed entry information and diffs
+        #[arg(short, long)]
+        verbose: bool,
+    },
+
+    /// Validate that every artifact in the run manifest exists and matches its hash
+    Validate {
+        /// Path to the verification run directory
+        run_dir: PathBuf,
+    },
+
+    /// Generate the report and immediately view it in the default browser
+    View {
+        /// Path to the verification run directory
+        run_dir: PathBuf,
+
+        /// Output directory for generated report
+        #[arg(short, long)]
+        output: Option<PathBuf>,
+    },
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+use crate::hurl_source::HurlSourceEntry;
+use crate::model::{Diagnostic, DiagnosticSeverity, EntryOutcome};
+use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
+
+pub struct QualityAnalyzer<'a> {
+    defined_variables: &'a HashSet<String>,
+}
+
+impl<'a> QualityAnalyzer<'a> {
+    pub fn new(defined_variables: &'a HashSet<String>) -> Self {
+        Self { defined_variables }
+    }
+
+    pub fn analyze_source_entry(&self, entry: &HurlSourceEntry, entry_id: &str) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
+        let mut diagnostics = Vec::new();
+
+        if entry.asserts.is_empty() {
+            diagnostics.push(Diagnostic {
+                code: "TQ001_NO_ASSERTIONS".to_string(),
+                severity: DiagnosticSeverity::Warning,
+                message: format!("Entry at line {} has no assertions", entry.line),
+                target_entity: Some(entry_id.to_string()),
+            });
+        }
+
+        for assert in &entry.asserts {
+            if assert.is_status_range {
+                diagnostics.push(Diagnostic {
+                    code: "TQ002_STATUS_RANGE_ASSERTION".to_string(),
+                    severity: DiagnosticSeverity::Warning,
+                    message: format!(
+                        "Negative entry at line {} asserts status range (e.g. >= 400) instead of exact error code/body",
+                        assert.line
+                    ),
+                    target_entity: Some(entry_id.to_string()),
+                });
+            }
+
+            if assert.is_weak_type {
+                diagnostics.push(Diagnostic {
+                    code: "TQ003_WEAK_TYPE_ASSERTION".to_string(),
+                    severity: DiagnosticSeverity::Info,
+                    message: format!(
+                        "Assertion at line {} checks only type without validating specific expected value",
+                        assert.line
+                    ),
+                    target_entity: Some(entry_id.to_string()),
+                });
+            }
+        }
+
+        for var in &entry.variables_used {
+            if !self.defined_variables.is_empty() && !self.defined_variables.contains(var) {
+                diagnostics.push(Diagnostic {
+                    code: "TQ004_UNDEFINED_VARIABLE".to_string(),
+                    severity: DiagnosticSeverity::Warning,
+                    message: format!(
+                        "Variable '{}' referenced at line {} is not in run variables",
+                        var, entry.line
+                    ),
+                    target_entity: Some(entry_id.to_string()),
+                });
+            }
+        }
+
+        if entry.is_retry && entry.asserts.is_empty() {
+            diagnostics.push(Diagnostic {
+                code: "TQ005_UNASSERTED_RETRY".to_string(),
+                severity: DiagnosticSeverity::Warning,
+                message: format!(
+                    "Entry with retry option at line {} has no assertions on effect",
+                    entry.line
+                ),
+                target_entity: Some(entry_id.to_string()),
+            });
+        }
+
+        diagnostics
+    }
+
+    pub fn check_replayed_requests(
+        &self,
+        request_map: &HashMap<String, Vec<(usize, Option<String>)>>,
+    ) -> Vec<Diagnostic> {
+        let mut diagnostics = Vec::new();
+
+        for (req_id, occurrences) in request_map {
+            if occurrences.len() > 1 {
+                let first_body = &occurrences[0].1;
+                for (idx, body) in &occurrences[1..] {
+                    if body != first_body {
+                        diagnostics.push(Diagnostic {
+                            code: "TQ006_REUSED_REQUEST_ID_BODY_MUTATION".to_string(),
+                            severity: DiagnosticSeverity::Info,
+                            message: format!(
+                                "Request ID '{}' was reused at entry #{} with a different payload body",
+                                req_id, idx
+                            ),
+                            target_entity: Some(format!("entry-{}", idx)),
+                        });
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        diagnostics
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn classify_entry_outcome(
+    has_failed_asserts: bool,
+    expected_status: Option<u16>,
+    actual_status: u16,
+    is_blocked: bool,
+    is_skipped: bool,
+    has_weak_asserts: bool,
+) -> EntryOutcome {
+    if is_blocked {
+        return EntryOutcome::Blocked;
+    }
+    if is_skipped {
+        return EntryOutcome::Skipped;
+    }
+
+    if expected_status
+        .is_some_and(|exp_st| exp_st >= 400 && actual_status == exp_st && !has_failed_asserts)
+    {
+        return EntryOutcome::ExpectedRejection;
+    }
+
+    if has_failed_asserts {
+        return EntryOutcome::Failed;
+    }
+
+    if has_weak_asserts {
+        return EntryOutcome::Weak;
+    }
+
+    EntryOutcome::Passed
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,174 @@
+use crate::model::{DiffItem, ProvenanceOrigin};
+use serde_json::Value;
+
+pub fn diff_json(
+    expected_str: &str,
+    actual_str: &str,
+    origin: ProvenanceOrigin,
+) -> Option<Vec<DiffItem>> {
+    let expected_val: Value = serde_json::from_str(expected_str).ok()?;
+    let actual_val: Value = serde_json::from_str(actual_str).ok()?;
+
+    let mut diffs = Vec::new();
+    compare_values("", &expected_val, &actual_val, origin, &mut diffs);
+    Some(diffs)
+}
+
+fn compare_values(
+    path: &str,
+    expected: &Value,
+    actual: &Value,
+    origin: ProvenanceOrigin,
+    diffs: &mut Vec<DiffItem>,
+) {
+    match (expected, actual) {
+        (Value::Object(exp_map), Value::Object(act_map)) => {
+            for (key, exp_v) in exp_map {
+                let sub_path = format!("{}/{}", path, escape_json_pointer(key));
+                if let Some(act_v) = act_map.get(key) {
+                    compare_values(&sub_path, exp_v, act_v, origin, diffs);
+                } else {
+                    diffs.push(DiffItem {
+                        path: sub_path,
+                        diff_type: "Removed".to_string(),
+                        expected: Some(exp_v.to_string()),
+                        actual: None,
+                        origin,
+                    });
+                }
+            }
+
+            for (key, act_v) in act_map {
+                if !exp_map.contains_key(key) {
+                    let sub_path = format!("{}/{}", path, escape_json_pointer(key));
+                    diffs.push(DiffItem {
+                        path: sub_path,
+                        diff_type: "Added".to_string(),
+                        expected: None,
+                        actual: Some(act_v.to_string()),
+                        origin,
+                    });
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        (Value::Array(exp_arr), Value::Array(act_arr)) => {
+            let max_len = std::cmp::max(exp_arr.len(), act_arr.len());
+            for i in 0..max_len {
+                let sub_path = format!("{}/{}", path, i);
+                match (exp_arr.get(i), act_arr.get(i)) {
+                    (Some(e), Some(a)) => {
+                        compare_values(&sub_path, e, a, origin, diffs);
+                    }
+                    (Some(e), None) => {
+                        diffs.push(DiffItem {
+                            path: sub_path,
+                            diff_type: "Removed".to_string(),
+                            expected: Some(e.to_string()),
+                            actual: None,
+                            origin,
+                        });
+                    }
+                    (None, Some(a)) => {
+                        diffs.push(DiffItem {
+                            path: sub_path,
+                            diff_type: "Added".to_string(),
+                            expected: None,
+                            actual: Some(a.to_string()),
+                            origin,
+                        });
+                    }
+                    (None, None) => {}
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        (exp, act) if exp != act => {
+            let diff_type = if discriminant_name(exp) != discriminant_name(act) {
+                "TypeMismatch"
+            } else {
+                "Changed"
+            };
+
+            diffs.push(DiffItem {
+                path: if path.is_empty() { "/" } else { path }.to_string(),
+                diff_type: diff_type.to_string(),
+                expected: Some(exp.to_string()),
+                actual: Some(act.to_string()),
+                origin,
+            });
+        }
+        _ => {}
+    }
+}
+
+fn discriminant_name(val: &Value) -> &'static str {
+    match val {
+        Value::Null => "null",
+        Value::Bool(_) => "bool",
+        Value::Number(_) => "number",
+        Value::String(_) => "string",
+        Value::Array(_) => "array",
+        Value::Object(_) => "object",
+    }
+}
+
+fn escape_json_pointer(key: &str) -> String {
+    key.replace('~', "~0").replace('/', "~1")
+}
+
+pub fn diff_scalar(
+    path: &str,
+    expected: Option<&str>,
+    actual: Option<&str>,
+    origin: ProvenanceOrigin,
+) -> Option<DiffItem> {
+    if expected == actual {
+        return None;
+    }
+
+    Some(DiffItem {
+        path: path.to_string(),
+        diff_type: "Changed".to_string(),
+        expected: expected.map(String::from),
+        actual: actual.map(String::from),
+        origin,
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    #[test]
+    fn test_json_diff_added_and_removed() {
+        let expected = r#"{"a": 1, "b": "hello"}"#;
+        let actual = r#"{"b": "hello", "c": true}"#;
+
+        let diffs = diff_json(expected, actual, ProvenanceOrigin::Derived).unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(diffs.len(), 2);
+
+        let removed = diffs.iter().find(|d| d.path == "/a").unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(removed.diff_type, "Removed");
+
+        let added = diffs.iter().find(|d| d.path == "/c").unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(added.diff_type, "Added");
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn test_json_diff_type_mismatch() {
+        let expected = r#"{"amount": 100}"#;
+        let actual = r#"{"amount": "100"}"#;
+
+        let diffs = diff_json(expected, actual, ProvenanceOrigin::Derived).unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(diffs.len(), 1);
+        assert_eq!(diffs[0].diff_type, "TypeMismatch");
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn test_json_diff_key_order_independence() {
+        let expected = r#"{"x": 1, "y": 2}"#;
+        let actual = r#"{"y": 2, "x": 1}"#;
+
+        let diffs = diff_json(expected, actual, ProvenanceOrigin::Derived).unwrap();
+        assert_eq!(diffs.len(), 0);
+    }
+}

+use std::path::PathBuf;
+use thiserror::Error;
+
+#[derive(Error, Debug)]
+pub enum TraceHurlError {
+    #[error("I/O error: {0}")]
+    Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
+
+    #[error("JSON error: {0}")]
+    Json(#[from] serde_json::Error),
+
+    #[error("Manifest file not found: {0}")]
+    ManifestNotFound(PathBuf),
+
+    #[error("Invalid manifest: {0}")]
+    ManifestInvalid(String),
+
+    #[error("Artifact not found: {0}")]
+    ArtifactMissing(String),
+
+    #[error("Artifact path escapes run directory: {0}")]
+    PathTraversal(String),
+
+    #[error("Hash mismatch for {path}: expected {expected}, actual {actual}")]
+    HashMismatch {
+        path: String,
+        expected: String,
+        actual: String,
+    },
+
+    #[error("Report generation failed: {0}")]
+    ReportGeneration(String),
+
+    #[error("Validation failed: {0}")]
+    ValidationFailed(String),
+
+    #[error("Open browser failed: {0}")]
+    OpenBrowser(String),
+}
+
+pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, TraceHurlError>;

+use crate::error::Result;
+use crate::model::HeaderItem;
+use serde::Deserialize;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+#[serde(untagged)]
+pub enum HurlJsonPayload {
+    Single(RawHurlReport),
+    Multiple(Vec<RawHurlReport>),
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlReport {
+    pub filename: Option<String>,
+    pub success: Option<bool>,
+    pub time: Option<u64>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub entries: Vec<RawHurlEntry>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlEntry {
+    pub index: usize,
+    pub line: usize,
+    pub time: Option<u64>,
+    pub curl_cmd: Option<String>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub asserts: Vec<RawHurlAssert>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub captures: Vec<RawHurlCapture>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub calls: Vec<RawHurlCall>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlAssert {
+    pub line: usize,
+    pub success: bool,
+    pub message: Option<String>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlCapture {
+    pub name: String,
+    pub value: serde_json::Value,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlCall {
+    pub request: RawHurlRequest,
+    pub response: Option<RawHurlResponse>,
+    pub timings: Option<RawHurlTimings>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlRequest {
+    pub method: String,
+    pub url: String,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub headers: Vec<HeaderItem>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub query_string: Vec<HeaderItem>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlResponse {
+    pub status: u16,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub headers: Vec<HeaderItem>,
+    pub http_version: Option<String>,
+    pub body: Option<serde_json::Value>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Deserialize)]
+pub struct RawHurlTimings {
+    pub begin_call: Option<String>,
+    pub end_call: Option<String>,
+    pub total: Option<u64>,
+}
+
+pub fn parse_hurl_json(json_content: &str) -> Result<Vec<RawHurlReport>> {
+    let payload: HurlJsonPayload = serde_json::from_str(json_content)?;
+    match payload {
+        HurlJsonPayload::Single(r) => Ok(vec![r]),
+        HurlJsonPayload::Multiple(v) => Ok(v),
+    }
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ParsedAssertMessage {
+    pub expression: Option<String>,
+    pub actual: Option<String>,
+    pub expected: Option<String>,
+    pub error_type: String,
+}
+
+pub fn parse_assert_message(msg: &str) -> ParsedAssertMessage {
+    let mut expression = None;
+    let mut actual = None;
+    let mut expected = None;
+    let error_type = if msg.contains("Undefined variable") {
+        "UndefinedVariable".to_string()
+    } else {
+        "AssertFailure".to_string()
+    };
+
+    for line in msg.lines() {
+        let trimmed = line.trim();
+        if let Some(pos) = trimmed.find('|') {
+            let after_pipe = trimmed[pos + 1..].trim();
+            if after_pipe.starts_with("actual:") {
+                let act = after_pipe.trim_start_matches("actual:").trim();
+                actual = Some(strip_type_wrapper(act));
+            } else if after_pipe.starts_with("expected:") {
+                let exp = after_pipe.trim_start_matches("expected:").trim();
+                expected = Some(strip_type_wrapper(exp));
+            } else if trimmed.chars().next().is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
+                expression = Some(after_pipe.to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    ParsedAssertMessage {
+        expression,
+        actual,
+        expected,
+        error_type,
+    }
+}
+
+fn strip_type_wrapper(raw: &str) -> String {
+    let s = raw.trim();
+    match (s.find('<'), s.rfind('>')) {
+        (Some(start), Some(end)) if end > start => s[start + 1..end].to_string(),
+        _ => s.to_string(),
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    #[test]
+    fn test_parse_assert_message_actual_expected() {
+        let msg = r#"error: Assert failure
+    --> /path/to/loan-import.hurl:20:0
+     |
+  20 | jsonpath "$.requestType" == "LOAN_CONVERSION"
+     |   actual:   string <loanConversion>
+     |   expected: string <LOAN_CONVERSION>
+     |"#;
+        let parsed = parse_assert_message(msg);
+        assert_eq!(parsed.actual, Some("loanConversion".to_string()));
+        assert_eq!(parsed.expected, Some("LOAN_CONVERSION".to_string()));
+        assert_eq!(
+            parsed.expression,
+            Some(r#"jsonpath "$.requestType" == "LOAN_CONVERSION""#.to_string())
+        );
+    }
+
+    #[test]
+    fn test_parse_hurl_json_array_and_single() {
+        let single_json = r#"{"entries": [{"index": 1, "line": 1}]}"#;
+        let single_parsed = parse_hurl_json(single_json).expect("single");
+        assert_eq!(single_parsed.len(), 1);
+
+        let array_json =
+            r#"[{"entries": [{"index": 1, "line": 1}]}, {"entries": [{"index": 2, "line": 5}]}]"#;
+        let array_parsed = parse_hurl_json(array_json).expect("array");
+        assert_eq!(array_parsed.len(), 2);
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,211 @@
+use regex::Regex;
+use std::collections::HashSet;
+use std::sync::LazyLock;
+
+static VAR_RE: LazyLock<Regex> = LazyLock::new(|| Regex::new(r"\{\{([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)\}\}").unwrap());
+static STATUS_RANGE_RE: LazyLock<Regex> =
+    LazyLock::new(|| Regex::new(r"status\s*>=\s*400").unwrap());
+static WEAK_TYPE_RE: LazyLock<Regex> =
+    LazyLock::new(|| Regex::new(r"(isString|isNumber|isBoolean|isCollection)").unwrap());
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct HurlSourceAssert {
+    pub line: usize,
+    pub raw: String,
+    pub is_status_range: bool,
+    pub is_weak_type: bool,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct HurlSourceEntry {
+    pub line: usize,
+    pub method: String,
+    pub url: String,
+    pub expected_status: Option<u16>,
+    pub payload_file: Option<String>,
+    pub captures: Vec<(String, String)>,
+    pub asserts: Vec<HurlSourceAssert>,
+    pub variables_used: HashSet<String>,
+    pub is_retry: bool,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct ParsedHurlSource {
+    pub scenario_name: String,
+    pub scenario_description: String,
+    pub entries: Vec<HurlSourceEntry>,
+}
+
+pub fn parse_hurl_source(content: &str, default_filename: &str) -> ParsedHurlSource {
+    let lines: Vec<&str> = content.lines().collect();
+    let mut scenario_name = default_filename.to_string();
+    let mut scenario_description = String::new();
+
+    let mut line_idx = 0;
+    while line_idx < lines.len() {
+        let line = lines[line_idx].trim();
+        if line.starts_with('#') {
+            let comment = line.trim_start_matches('#').trim();
+            if scenario_description.is_empty() {
+                if let Some(stripped) = comment.strip_prefix("Scenario:") {
+                    scenario_name = stripped.trim().to_string();
+                } else if !comment.is_empty() {
+                    scenario_name = comment.to_string();
+                }
+                scenario_description = comment.to_string();
+            } else {
+                scenario_description.push(' ');
+                scenario_description.push_str(comment);
+            }
+            line_idx += 1;
+        } else if line.is_empty() {
+            line_idx += 1;
+        } else {
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+
+    let mut entries = Vec::new();
+    let mut current_entry: Option<HurlSourceEntry> = None;
+    let mut in_captures = false;
+    let mut in_asserts = false;
+    let mut in_options = false;
+
+    for (idx, line_raw) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
+        let line_num = idx + 1;
+        let line = line_raw.trim();
+
+        if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        let is_http_request = is_method_start(line);
+        if is_http_request {
+            if let Some(entry) = current_entry.take() {
+                entries.push(entry);
+            }
+            in_captures = false;
+            in_asserts = false;
+            in_options = false;
+
+            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
+            let method = parts.first().unwrap_or(&"GET").to_string();
+            let url = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"").to_string();
+
+            let mut vars = HashSet::new();
+            for cap in VAR_RE.captures_iter(line) {
+                if let Some(var_match) = cap.get(1) {
+                    vars.insert(var_match.as_str().to_string());
+                }
+            }
+
+            current_entry = Some(HurlSourceEntry {
+                line: line_num,
+                method,
+                url,
+                expected_status: None,
+                payload_file: None,
+                captures: Vec::new(),
+                asserts: Vec::new(),
+                variables_used: vars,
+                is_retry: false,
+            });
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        if let Some(entry) = current_entry.as_mut() {
+            for cap in VAR_RE.captures_iter(line) {
+                if let Some(var_match) = cap.get(1) {
+                    entry.variables_used.insert(var_match.as_str().to_string());
+                }
+            }
+
+            if line.starts_with("file,") {
+                let file_part = line
+                    .trim_start_matches("file,")
+                    .trim()
+                    .trim_end_matches(';');
+                entry.payload_file = Some(file_part.to_string());
+            } else if line.starts_with("HTTP ") || line.starts_with("HTTP/") {
+                if let Some(st) = line
+                    .split_whitespace()
+                    .nth(1)
+                    .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u16>().ok())
+                {
+                    entry.expected_status = Some(st);
+                }
+            } else if line == "[Captures]" {
+                in_captures = true;
+                in_asserts = false;
+                in_options = false;
+            } else if line == "[Asserts]" {
+                in_asserts = true;
+                in_captures = false;
+                in_options = false;
+            } else if line == "[Options]" {
+                in_options = true;
+                in_captures = false;
+                in_asserts = false;
+            } else if in_options {
+                if line.starts_with("retry:") {
+                    entry.is_retry = true;
+                }
+            } else if in_captures {
+                if let Some(colon_pos) = line.find(':') {
+                    let cap_name = line[..colon_pos].trim().to_string();
+                    let cap_expr = line[colon_pos + 1..].trim().to_string();
+                    entry.captures.push((cap_name, cap_expr));
+                }
+            } else if in_asserts {
+                let is_status_range = STATUS_RANGE_RE.is_match(line);
+                let is_weak_type = WEAK_TYPE_RE.is_match(line);
+                entry.asserts.push(HurlSourceAssert {
+                    line: line_num,
+                    raw: line.to_string(),
+                    is_status_range,
+                    is_weak_type,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if let Some(entry) = current_entry {
+        entries.push(entry);
+    }
+
+    ParsedHurlSource {
+        scenario_name,
+        scenario_description,
+        entries,
+    }
+}
+
+fn is_method_start(line: &str) -> bool {
+    let methods = [
+        "GET ", "POST ", "PUT ", "DELETE ", "PATCH ", "HEAD ", "OPTIONS ",
+    ];
+    methods.iter().any(|m| line.starts_with(m))
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+mod tests {
+    use super::*;
+
+    #[test]
+    fn test_parse_hurl_source_scenario_header() {
+        let content = r#"# Scenario: Loan Import Happy Path
+# Verifies successful import of valid loans
+POST http://localhost:8081/import
+HTTP 202
+[Asserts]
+jsonpath "$.status" == "Accepted"
+"#;
+        let parsed = parse_hurl_source(content, "test.hurl");
+        assert_eq!(parsed.scenario_name, "Loan Import Happy Path");
+        assert!(parsed.scenario_description.contains("Verifies successful"));
+        assert_eq!(parsed.entries.len(), 1);
+        assert_eq!(parsed.entries[0].method, "POST");
+        assert_eq!(parsed.entries[0].expected_status, Some(202));
+        assert_eq!(parsed.entries[0].asserts.len(), 1);
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,717 @@
+use crate::diagnostics::{QualityAnalyzer, classify_entry_outcome};
+use crate::diff::{diff_json, diff_scalar};
+use crate::error::Result;
+use crate::hurl_json::{RawHurlReport, parse_assert_message, parse_hurl_json};
+use crate::hurl_source::{ParsedHurlSource, parse_hurl_source};
+use crate::manifest::{Manifest, synthesize_manifest};
+use crate::model::*;
+use crate::redaction::{RedactionConfig, Redactor};
+use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
+use std::path::Path;
+
+pub fn ingest_run_directory(run_dir: &Path) -> Result<Run> {
+    let manifest = match Manifest::load_from_dir(run_dir) {
+        Ok(m) => m,
+        Err(_) => synthesize_manifest(run_dir)?,
+    };
+
+    let mut redaction_config = RedactionConfig::default();
+    if let Some(ref r) = manifest.redaction {
+        for h in &r.headers {
+            redaction_config.headers.insert(h.to_ascii_lowercase());
+        }
+    }
+    let redactor = Redactor::new(redaction_config);
+
+    let hurl_reports = load_hurl_reports(run_dir, &manifest)?;
+    let parsed_sources = load_hurl_sources(run_dir, &manifest)?;
+
+    let mut defined_variables: HashSet<String> = manifest.variables.keys().cloned().collect();
+    defined_variables.insert("run_id".to_string());
+    defined_variables.insert("aion_url".to_string());
+    defined_variables.insert("tenant_id".to_string());
+    defined_variables.insert("source_account_id".to_string());
+
+    let quality_analyzer = QualityAnalyzer::new(&defined_variables);
+
+    let mut scenarios = Vec::new();
+    let mut all_diagnostics = Vec::new();
+    let mut request_map: HashMap<String, Vec<(usize, Option<String>)>> = HashMap::new();
+
+    for (scenario_idx, (source_file, source_parsed)) in parsed_sources.iter().enumerate() {
+        let scenario_id = format!("scenario-{}", scenario_idx + 1);
+
+        let report = hurl_reports
+            .iter()
+            .find(|r| {
+                r.filename
+                    .as_ref()
+                    .is_some_and(|f| f.ends_with(source_file) || source_file.ends_with(f))
+            })
+            .or_else(|| hurl_reports.first());
+
+        let ctx = ScenarioProcessContext {
+            scenario_id: &scenario_id,
+            source_file,
+            source_parsed,
+            report,
+            redactor: &redactor,
+            quality_analyzer: &quality_analyzer,
+            run_dir,
+        };
+
+        let (entries, scenario_diags, scenario_captures) =
+            process_scenario_entries(&ctx, &mut request_map);
+
+        all_diagnostics.extend(scenario_diags);
+
+        let summary = compute_scenario_summary(&entries);
+
+        scenarios.push(Scenario {
+            id: scenario_id,
+            source_file: source_file.clone(),
+            name: source_parsed.scenario_name.clone(),
+            description: source_parsed.scenario_description.clone(),
+            entries,
+            summary,
+            all_captures: scenario_captures,
+        });
+    }
+
+    all_diagnostics.extend(quality_analyzer.check_replayed_requests(&request_map));
+
+    let phases = process_phases(&manifest);
+    let run_summary = compute_run_summary(&scenarios, &phases, all_diagnostics.len());
+
+    let artifacts: Vec<Artifact> = manifest
+        .artifacts
+        .iter()
+        .map(|a| Artifact {
+            path: a.path.clone(),
+            artifact_type: a.artifact_type.clone(),
+            size_bytes: a.size_bytes,
+            sha256: a.sha256.clone(),
+            sensitivity: a.sensitivity,
+        })
+        .collect();
+
+    Ok(Run {
+        schema_version: manifest.schema_version,
+        run_id: manifest.run_id,
+        started_at: manifest.started_at,
+        finished_at: manifest.finished_at,
+        tools: manifest.tools,
+        phases,
+        scenarios,
+        artifacts,
+        variables: manifest.variables,
+        diagnostics: all_diagnostics,
+        summary: run_summary,
+    })
+}
+
+fn load_hurl_reports(run_dir: &Path, manifest: &Manifest) -> Result<Vec<RawHurlReport>> {
+    let mut reports = Vec::new();
+
+    for art in &manifest.artifacts {
+        if art.path.ends_with(".json")
+            && (art.path.contains("functional")
+                || art.path.contains("hurl")
+                || art.path.contains("report"))
+        {
+            let full_path = run_dir.join(&art.path);
+            if let Some(r_list) = try_read_hurl_report(&full_path) {
+                reports.extend(r_list);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if reports.is_empty()
+        && let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(run_dir)
+    {
+        for entry in entries.flatten() {
+            let path = entry.path();
+            if path.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "json")
+                && let Some(r_list) = try_read_hurl_report(&path)
+            {
+                reports.extend(r_list);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    Ok(reports)
+}
+
+fn try_read_hurl_report(path: &Path) -> Option<Vec<RawHurlReport>> {
+    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(path).ok()?;
+    parse_hurl_json(&content).ok()
+}
+
+fn load_hurl_sources(
+    run_dir: &Path,
+    manifest: &Manifest,
+) -> Result<Vec<(String, ParsedHurlSource)>> {
+    let mut sources = Vec::new();
+
+    for sc in &manifest.scenarios {
+        let full_path = run_dir.join(&sc.file);
+        if let Some(source) = try_read_hurl_source(&full_path, &sc.name) {
+            sources.push(source);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if sources.is_empty() {
+        for art in &manifest.artifacts {
+            if art.path.ends_with(".hurl") {
+                let full_path = run_dir.join(&art.path);
+                if let Some(source) = try_read_hurl_source(&full_path, &art.path) {
+                    sources.push(source);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if sources.is_empty()
+        && let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(run_dir)
+    {
+        for entry in entries.flatten() {
+            let path = entry.path();
+            if path.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "hurl") {
+                let rel = path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().to_string();
+                if let Some(source) = try_read_hurl_source(&path, &rel) {
+                    sources.push(source);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    Ok(sources)
+}

+    pub scenario_id: &'a str,
+    pub source_file: &'a str,
+    pub source_parsed: &'a ParsedHurlSource,
+    pub report: Option<&'a RawHurlReport>,

+}
+
+fn parse_scalar_or_json(s: &str) -> serde_json::Value {
+    let trimmed = s.trim();
+    if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed == "null" {
+        return serde_json::Value::Null;
+    }
+    if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(trimmed) {
+        return v;
+    }
+    if let Ok(n) = trimmed.parse::<i64>() {
+        return serde_json::Value::Number(n.into());
+    }
+    if let Some(num) = trimmed
+        .parse::<f64>()
+        .ok()
+        .and_then(serde_json::Number::from_f64)
+    {
+        return serde_json::Value::Number(num);
+    }
+    if let Ok(b) = trimmed.parse::<bool>() {
+        return serde_json::Value::Bool(b);
+    }
+    serde_json::Value::String(trimmed.trim_matches('"').to_string())
+}
+
+fn set_json_path_value(root: &mut serde_json::Value, path_str: &str, val: serde_json::Value) {
+    let clean_path = path_str
+        .trim()
+        .trim_start_matches("jsonpath")
+        .trim()
+        .trim_matches('"');
+    let path = if let Some(stripped) = clean_path.strip_prefix("$.") {
+        stripped
+    } else if let Some(stripped) = clean_path.strip_prefix('$') {
+        stripped
+    } else {
+        clean_path
+    };
+
+    let segments: Vec<&str> = path.split('.').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
+    if segments.is_empty() {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let mut current = root;
+    for (i, seg) in segments.iter().enumerate() {
+        if i == segments.len() - 1 {
+            if let serde_json::Value::Object(map) = current {
+                map.insert(seg.to_string(), val);
+                return;
+            }
+        } else {
+            if !current.is_object() {
+                *current = serde_json::Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new());
+            }
+            if let serde_json::Value::Object(map) = current {
+                current = map
+                    .entry(seg.to_string())
+                    .or_insert_with(|| serde_json::Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new()));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn process_scenario_entries(
+    ctx: &ScenarioProcessContext<'_>,
+    request_map: &mut HashMap<String, Vec<(usize, Option<String>)>>,
+) -> (Vec<Entry>, Vec<Diagnostic>, Vec<Capture>) {
+    let mut entries = Vec::new();
+    let mut diagnostics = Vec::new();
+    let mut capture_table: HashMap<String, (usize, String, CaptureStatus)> = HashMap::new();
+    let mut capture_consumers: HashMap<String, Vec<usize>> = HashMap::new();
+
+    let accounts_json = std::fs::read_to_string(ctx.run_dir.join("created-accounts.json"))
+        .ok()
+        .and_then(|c| serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&c).ok());
+    if let Some(json) = accounts_json {
+        let accs = json
+            .get("accounts")
+            .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
+            .cloned()
+            .unwrap_or_default();
+        for acc in accs {
+            if let (Some(name), Some(val)) =
+                (acc.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()), acc.get("value"))
+            {
+                let val_str = match val {
+                    serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
+                    v => v.to_string(),
+                };
+                capture_table.insert(name.to_string(), (0, val_str, CaptureStatus::Ok));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    let raw_entries = ctx.report.map(|r| &r.entries[..]).unwrap_or(&[]);
+
+    for (entry_idx, source_entry) in ctx.source_parsed.entries.iter().enumerate() {
+        let current_index = entry_idx + 1;
+        let entry_id = format!("{}-entry-{}", ctx.scenario_id, current_index);
+
+        let raw_entry = raw_entries
+            .iter()
+            .find(|e| e.index == current_index || e.line == source_entry.line);
+
+        let mut assertions = Vec::new();
+        let mut diffs = Vec::new();
+        let mut has_failed_asserts = false;
+        let mut has_weak_asserts = false;
+
+        if let Some(raw) = raw_entry {
+            for assert in &raw.asserts {
+                let parsed_msg = assert.message.as_deref().map(parse_assert_message);
+                let passed = assert.success;
+                if !passed {
+                    has_failed_asserts = true;
+                }
+
+                let expression = parsed_msg
+                    .as_ref()
+                    .and_then(|p| p.expression.clone())
+                    .or_else(|| {
+                        source_entry
+                            .asserts
+                            .iter()
+                            .find(|a| a.line == assert.line)
+                            .map(|a| a.raw.clone())
+                    })
+                    .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("assert on line {}", assert.line));
+
+                let comparison_target = if expression.starts_with("jsonpath ") {
+                    expression
+                        .split_whitespace()
+                        .nth(1)
+                        .unwrap_or("jsonpath")
+                        .trim_matches('"')
+                        .to_string()
+                } else if expression.starts_with("status ") || expression.starts_with("HTTP ") {
+                    "status".to_string()
+                } else {
+                    "assertion".to_string()
+                };
+
+                let expected = parsed_msg.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.expected.clone());
+                let actual = parsed_msg.as_ref().and_then(|p| p.actual.clone());
+
+                if !passed && let (Some(exp), Some(act)) = (&expected, &actual) {
+                    if let Some(json_diffs) = diff_json(exp, act, ProvenanceOrigin::Recorded) {
+                        diffs.extend(json_diffs);
+                    } else if let Some(scalar_diff) = diff_scalar(
+                        &comparison_target,
+                        Some(exp),
+                        Some(act),
+                        ProvenanceOrigin::Recorded,
+                    ) {
+                        diffs.push(scalar_diff);
+                    }
+                }
+
+                assertions.push(Assertion {
+                    line: assert.line,
+                    expression,
+                    comparison_target,
+                    expected,
+                    actual,
+                    passed,
+                    message: assert.message.clone(),
+                    origin: ProvenanceOrigin::Recorded,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+
+        for sa in &source_entry.asserts {
+            if sa.is_status_range || sa.is_weak_type {
+                has_weak_asserts = true;
+            }
+        }
+
+        let entry_diags = ctx
+            .quality_analyzer
+            .analyze_source_entry(source_entry, &entry_id);
+        diagnostics.extend(entry_diags);
+
+        let mut captures_set = Vec::new();
+        if let Some(raw) = raw_entry {
+            for cap in &raw.captures {
+                let val_str = match &cap.value {
+                    serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
+                    v => v.to_string(),
+                };
+                let status = if has_failed_asserts {
+                    CaptureStatus::Failed
+                } else {
+                    CaptureStatus::Ok
+                };
+
+                capture_table.insert(cap.name.clone(), (current_index, val_str.clone(), status));
+
+                captures_set.push(Capture {
+                    name: cap.name.clone(),
+                    source_entry_index: current_index,
+                    value: ctx.redactor.redact_text(&val_str),
+                    status,
+                    dependent_entries: Vec::new(),
+                });
+            }
+        }
+
+        let mut captures_used = Vec::new();
+        for var in &source_entry.variables_used {
+            if capture_table.contains_key(var) {
+                captures_used.push(var.clone());
+                capture_consumers
+                    .entry(var.clone())
+                    .or_default()
+                    .push(current_index);
+            }
+        }
+
+        let call = raw_entry.and_then(|r| r.calls.first());
+        let request = if let Some(c) = call {
+            let mut headers = Vec::new();
+            for h in &c.request.headers {
+                headers.push(HeaderItem {
+                    name: h.name.clone(),
+                    value: ctx.redactor.redact_header_value(&h.name, &h.value),
+                });
+            }
+
+            let mut body_snippet = None;
+            if let Some(ref pf) = source_entry.payload_file {
+                let payload_path = ctx.run_dir.join(pf);
+                if let Ok(c) = std::fs::read_to_string(&payload_path) {
+                    body_snippet = Some(ctx.redactor.redact_text(&c));
+                }
+            }
+
+            RequestData {
+                method: c.request.method.clone(),
+                url: ctx.redactor.redact_url(&c.request.url),
+                headers,
+                query_string: c.request.query_string.clone(),
+                body_snippet,
+                body_path: source_entry.payload_file.clone(),
+            }
+        } else {
+            RequestData {
+                method: source_entry.method.clone(),
+                url: ctx.redactor.redact_url(&source_entry.url),
+                headers: Vec::new(),
+                query_string: Vec::new(),
+                body_snippet: None,
+                body_path: source_entry.payload_file.clone(),
+            }
+        };
+
+        if let Some(ref pf) = source_entry.payload_file {
+            request_map
+                .entry(pf.clone())
+                .or_default()
+                .push((current_index, request.body_snippet.clone()));
+        }
+
+        let mut actual_json = serde_json::Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new());
+        let mut expected_json = serde_json::Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new());
+        let mut has_json_asserts = false;
+
+        for a in &assertions {
+            if a.comparison_target.contains("jsonpath") || a.comparison_target.starts_with("$.") {
+                has_json_asserts = true;
+                if let Some(ref exp) = a.expected {
+                    let parsed_exp = parse_scalar_or_json(exp);
+                    set_json_path_value(&mut expected_json, &a.comparison_target, parsed_exp);
+                }
+                if a.passed {
+                    if let Some(ref exp) = a.expected {
+                        let parsed_val = parse_scalar_or_json(exp);
+                        set_json_path_value(&mut actual_json, &a.comparison_target, parsed_val);
+                    }
+                } else if let Some(act) = a
+                    .actual
+                    .as_deref()
+                    .filter(|act| *act != "none" && *act != "null")
+                {
+                    let parsed_act = parse_scalar_or_json(act);
+                    set_json_path_value(&mut actual_json, &a.comparison_target, parsed_act);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        let response = call.and_then(|c| {
+            c.response.as_ref().map(|res| {
+                let mut headers = Vec::new();
+                for h in &res.headers {
+                    headers.push(HeaderItem {
+                        name: h.name.clone(),
+                        value: ctx.redactor.redact_header_value(&h.name, &h.value),
+                    });
+                }
+
+                let mut body_snippet = None;
+                let mut body_path = None;
+                if let Some(ref b) = res.body {
+                    if let Some(path_str) = b.as_str() {
+                        let potential_path = ctx.run_dir.join(path_str);
+                        if potential_path.exists() {
+                            if let Ok(c) = std::fs::read_to_string(&potential_path) {
+                                body_snippet = Some(ctx.redactor.redact_text(&c));
+                                body_path = Some(path_str.to_string());
+                            }
+                        } else {
+                            body_snippet = Some(ctx.redactor.redact_text(path_str));
+                        }
+                    } else {
+                        body_snippet = Some(ctx.redactor.redact_text(&b.to_string()));
+                    }
+                }
+
+                let (body_snippet, is_derived) = if let Some(snip) = body_snippet {
+                    (Some(snip), false)
+                } else if has_json_asserts
+                    && actual_json.is_object()
+                    && !actual_json.as_object().unwrap().is_empty()
+                {
+                    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&actual_json).ok();
+                    (pretty, true)
+                } else {
+                    (None, false)
+                };
+
+                let expected_body_snippet = if has_json_asserts
+                    && expected_json.is_object()
+                    && !expected_json.as_object().unwrap().is_empty()
+                {
+                    serde_json::to_string_pretty(&expected_json).ok()
+                } else {
+                    None
+                };
+
+                ResponseData {
+                    status: res.status,
+                    headers,
+                    http_version: res.http_version.clone(),
+                    body_snippet,
+                    body_path,
+                    is_derived,
+                    expected_body_snippet,
+                }
+            })
+        });
+
+        let diffs = if let Some(ref res) = response {
+            if let (Some(exp_body), Some(act_body)) =
+                (&res.expected_body_snippet, &res.body_snippet)
+            {
+                if let Some(computed) = diff_json(exp_body, act_body, ProvenanceOrigin::Derived) {
+                    if !computed.is_empty() {
+                        computed
+                    } else {
+                        diffs
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    diffs
+                }
+            } else {
+                diffs
+            }
+        } else {
+            diffs
+        };
+
+        let status_code = response.as_ref().map(|r| r.status).unwrap_or(0);
+        let outcome = classify_entry_outcome(
+            has_failed_asserts,
+            source_entry.expected_status,
+            status_code,
+            false,
+            false,
+            has_weak_asserts,
+        );
+
+        let duration_ms = raw_entry.and_then(|r| r.time).unwrap_or(0);
+
+        let curl_cmd = raw_entry
+            .and_then(|r| r.curl_cmd.as_ref())
+            .map(|cmd| ctx.redactor.redact_curl_cmd(cmd));
+
+        entries.push(Entry {
+            id: entry_id,
+            index: current_index,
+            scenario_id: ctx.scenario_id.to_string(),
+            source_file: ctx.source_file.to_string(),
+            source_line: source_entry.line,
+            method: request.method.clone(),
+            url: request.url.clone(),
+            status_code,
+            outcome,
+            duration_ms,
+            request,
+            response,
+            assertions,
+            captures_set,
+            captures_used,
+            diffs,
+            curl_cmd,
+        });
+    }
+
+    for entry in &mut entries {
+        for cap in &mut entry.captures_set {
+            if let Some(consumers) = capture_consumers.get(&cap.name) {
+                cap.dependent_entries = consumers.clone();
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    let mut all_captures = Vec::new();
+    for (name, (source_idx, val_str, status)) in &capture_table {
+        let deps = capture_consumers.get(name).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
+        all_captures.push(Capture {
+            name: name.clone(),
+            source_entry_index: *source_idx,
+            value: ctx.redactor.redact_text(val_str),
+            status: *status,
+            dependent_entries: deps,
+        });
+    }
+    all_captures.sort_by_key(|c| c.source_entry_index);
+
+    (entries, diagnostics, all_captures)
+}
+
+fn process_phases(manifest: &Manifest) -> Vec<Phase> {
+    manifest
+        .phases
+        .iter()
+        .map(|p| {
+            let status = match p.exit_code {
+                Some(0) => PhaseStatus::Passed,
+                Some(2) => PhaseStatus::Blocked,
+                Some(_) => PhaseStatus::Failed,
+                None => PhaseStatus::NotRun,
+            };
+
+            Phase {
+                name: p.name.clone(),
+                status,
+                exit_code: p.exit_code,
+                start_time: p.start_time.clone(),
+                end_time: p.end_time.clone(),
+                duration_ms: None,
+                log_path: p.log_path.clone(),
+            }
+        })
+        .collect()
+}
+
+fn compute_scenario_summary(entries: &[Entry]) -> ScenarioSummary {
+    let mut summary = ScenarioSummary {
+        total_entries: entries.len(),
+        ..Default::default()
+    };
+
+    for e in entries {
+        match e.outcome {
+            EntryOutcome::Passed => summary.passed += 1,
+            EntryOutcome::Failed => summary.failed += 1,
+            EntryOutcome::ExpectedRejection => summary.expected_rejections += 1,
+            EntryOutcome::Blocked => summary.blocked += 1,
+            EntryOutcome::Skipped => summary.skipped += 1,
+            EntryOutcome::Weak => summary.weak += 1,
+            EntryOutcome::NotExecuted => {}
+        }
+    }
+
+    summary
+}
+
+fn compute_run_summary(
+    scenarios: &[Scenario],
+    phases: &[Phase],
+    total_diagnostics: usize,
+) -> RunSummary {
+    let mut summary = RunSummary {
+        total_scenarios: scenarios.len(),
+        total_diagnostics,
+        ..Default::default()
+    };
+
+    for sc in scenarios {
+        summary.total_entries += sc.summary.total_entries;
+        summary.passed_entries += sc.summary.passed;
+        summary.failed_entries += sc.summary.failed;
+        summary.expected_rejections += sc.summary.expected_rejections;
+        summary.blocked_entries += sc.summary.blocked;
+        summary.skipped_entries += sc.summary.skipped;
+        summary.weak_entries += sc.summary.weak;
+    }
+
+    let has_phase_failure = phases.iter().any(|p| p.status == PhaseStatus::Failed);
+    let has_phase_blocked = phases.iter().any(|p| p.status == PhaseStatus::Blocked);
+
+    if has_phase_blocked || summary.blocked_entries > 0 {
+        summary.overall_status = "BLOCKED".to_string();
+    } else if has_phase_failure || summary.failed_entries > 0 {
+        summary.overall_status = "FAILED".to_string();
+    } else {
+        summary.overall_status = "PASSED".to_string();
+    }
+
+    summary
+}

+use clap::Parser;

+fn main() -> ExitCode {
+    let cli = Cli::parse();
+
+    match run_app(cli) {
+        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
+        Err(err) => {
+            eprintln!("error: {}", err);
+            ExitCode::from(1)
+        }
+    }

+
+fn run_app(cli: Cli) -> Result<()> {
+    match cli.command {
+        Commands::Report {
+            run_dir,
+            output,
+            open,
+        } => execute_report(&run_dir, output.as_deref(), open),
+        Commands::View { run_dir, output } => execute_report(&run_dir, output.as_deref(), true),
+        Commands::Inspect { run_dir, verbose } => execute_inspect(&run_dir, verbose),
+        Commands::Validate { run_dir } => execute_validate(&run_dir),
+    }
+}
+
+fn execute_report(run_dir: &Path, output: Option<&Path>, open: bool) -> Result<()> {
+    let run = ingest_run_directory(run_dir)?;
+
+    let target_dir: PathBuf = match output {
+        Some(out) => out.to_path_buf(),
+        None => run_dir.join("report"),
+    };
+
+    let parent_dir = target_dir.parent().unwrap_or(run_dir);
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(parent_dir)?;
+
+    let tmp_dir = parent_dir.join(format!(".report.tmp.{}", std::process::id()));
+    if tmp_dir.exists() {
+        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir)?;
+    }
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp_dir)?;
+
+    let html_tmp_path = tmp_dir.join("index.html");
+    render_report_to_file(&run, &html_tmp_path)?;
+
+    let json_tmp_path = tmp_dir.join("report.json");
+    let json_data = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&run)?;
+    std::fs::write(&json_tmp_path, json_data)?;
+
+    if target_dir.exists() {
+        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&target_dir)?;
+    }
+    std::fs::rename(&tmp_dir, &target_dir)?;
+
+    let manifest_path = run_dir.join("manifest.json");
+    if !manifest_path.exists()
+        && let Ok(manifest) = tracehurl::manifest::synthesize_manifest(run_dir)
+    {
+        let _ = manifest.save_to_dir(run_dir);
+    }
+
+    let final_html = target_dir.join("index.html");
+    let final_json = target_dir.join("report.json");
+
+    println!("TraceHurl Report Generated Successfully:");
+    println!("  Run ID:    {}", run.run_id);
+    println!("  Status:    {}", run.summary.overall_status);
+    println!(
+        "  Entries:   {} total ({} passed, {} failed, {} rejections, {} weak)",
+        run.summary.total_entries,
+        run.summary.passed_entries,
+        run.summary.failed_entries,
+        run.summary.expected_rejections,
+        run.summary.weak_entries
+    );
+    println!("  HTML view: {}", final_html.display());
+    println!("  JSON data: {}", final_json.display());
+
+    if open {
+        println!("Opening report in default browser...");
+        opener::open(&final_html).map_err(|e| {
+            tracehurl::error::TraceHurlError::OpenBrowser(format!(
+                "{}: {}",
+                final_html.display(),
+                e
+            ))
+        })?;
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}

+fn execute_inspect(run_dir: &Path, verbose: bool) -> Result<()> {

+    println!("Total Entries:  {}", run.summary.total_entries);
+    println!("Passed:         {}", run.summary.passed_entries);
+    println!("Failed:         {}", run.summary.failed_entries);
+    println!("Rejections:     {}", run.summary.expected_rejections);
+    println!("Weak:           {}", run.summary.weak_entries);
+    println!("Diagnostics:    {}", run.diagnostics.len());
+
+    println!("\n--- Phases ---");
+    for phase in &run.phases {

+        for entry in &sc.entries {
+            let mark = match entry.outcome {
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::Passed => "✓",
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::Failed => "✗",
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::ExpectedRejection => "R",
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::Weak => "W",
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::Blocked => "B",
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::Skipped => "S",
+                tracehurl::model::EntryOutcome::NotExecuted => "-",
+            };
+            println!(
+                "    [{}] #{:<3} {:<6} {:<45} -> status: {} ({:?})",
+                mark,
+                entry.index,
+                entry.method,
+                truncate_str(&entry.url, 45),
+                entry.status_code,
+                entry.outcome
+            );
+
+            if verbose && !entry.assertions.is_empty() {
+                for assert in &entry.assertions {
+                    let a_mark = if assert.passed { "  ✓" } else { "  ✗" };
+                    println!(
+                        "        {} line {}: {} (exp: {:?}, act: {:?})",
+                        a_mark, assert.line, assert.expression, assert.expected, assert.actual
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+
+            if verbose && !entry.diffs.is_empty() {
+                for diff in &entry.diffs {
+                    println!(
+                        "        [DIFF] {} {} exp: {:?} act: {:?}",
+                        diff.diff_type, diff.path, diff.expected, diff.actual
+                    );
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if !run.diagnostics.is_empty() {
+        println!("\n--- Diagnostics ({}) ---", run.diagnostics.len());
+        for diag in &run.diagnostics {
+            println!("  [{:?}] {}: {}", diag.severity, diag.code, diag.message);
+        }
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn execute_validate(run_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {
+    println!("Validating manifest artifacts in: {}", run_dir.display());
+    let manifest = match Manifest::load_from_dir(run_dir) {
+        Ok(m) => m,
+        Err(_) => {
+            println!("Manifest not found; synthesizing manifest from run artifacts...");
+            let m = tracehurl::manifest::synthesize_manifest(run_dir)?;
+            m.save_to_dir(run_dir)?;
+            m
+        }
+    };
+    manifest.validate_artifacts(run_dir)?;
+    println!(
+        "✓ Validation PASSED: all {} artifacts exist and match SHA-256 hashes.",
+        manifest.artifacts.len()
+    );
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn truncate_str(s: &str, max_len: usize) -> String {
+    if s.len() > max_len {
+        format!("{}...", &s[..max_len - 3])
+    } else {
+        s.to_string()
+    }
+}

+use crate::error::{Result, TraceHurlError};
+use crate::model::SensitivityClass;
+use hex::encode as hex_encode;
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
+use std::collections::HashMap;
+use std::fs::File;
+use std::io::Read;
+use std::path::Path;
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct ManifestPhase {
+    pub name: String,
+    pub exit_code: Option<i32>,
+    pub start_time: Option<String>,
+    pub end_time: Option<String>,
+    pub log_path: Option<String>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct ManifestScenario {
+    pub file: String,
+    pub name: String,
+    pub entry_count: Option<usize>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct ManifestArtifact {
+    pub path: String,
+    #[serde(rename = "type")]
+    pub artifact_type: String,
+    pub size_bytes: u64,
+    pub sha256: String,
+    pub sensitivity: SensitivityClass,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct ManifestRedaction {
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub headers: Vec<String>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub json_paths: Vec<String>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub text_patterns: Vec<String>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
+pub struct Manifest {
+    pub schema_version: u32,
+    pub run_id: String,
+    pub started_at: Option<String>,
+    pub finished_at: Option<String>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub tools: HashMap<String, String>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub phases: Vec<ManifestPhase>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub scenarios: Vec<ManifestScenario>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub artifacts: Vec<ManifestArtifact>,
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub variables: HashMap<String, String>,
+    pub redaction: Option<ManifestRedaction>,
+    pub live: Option<serde_json::Value>,
+}
+
+impl Manifest {
+    pub fn load_from_dir(run_dir: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
+        let manifest_path = run_dir.join("manifest.json");
+        if !manifest_path.exists() {
+            return Err(TraceHurlError::ManifestNotFound(manifest_path));
+        }
+
+        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&manifest_path)?;
+        let manifest: Manifest = serde_json::from_str(&content)?;
+        Ok(manifest)
+    }
+
+    pub fn save_to_dir(&self, run_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {
+        let manifest_path = run_dir.join("manifest.json");
+        let content = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self)?;
+        std::fs::write(&manifest_path, content)?;
+        Ok(())
+    }
+
+    pub fn validate_artifacts(&self, run_dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {
+        let canonical_run_dir = run_dir.canonicalize()?;
+
+        for artifact in &self.artifacts {
+            if artifact.path.contains("..")
+                || artifact.path.starts_with('/')
+                || artifact.path.starts_with('\\')
+            {
+                return Err(TraceHurlError::PathTraversal(artifact.path.clone()));
+            }
+
+            let full_path = run_dir.join(&artifact.path);
+            if !full_path.exists() {
+                return Err(TraceHurlError::ArtifactMissing(artifact.path.clone()));
+            }
+
+            let canonical_art_path = full_path.canonicalize()?;
+            if !canonical_art_path.starts_with(&canonical_run_dir) {
+                return Err(TraceHurlError::PathTraversal(artifact.path.clone()));
+            }
+
+            let actual_hash = compute_sha256(&full_path)?;
+            if actual_hash.to_lowercase() != artifact.sha256.to_lowercase() {
+                return Err(TraceHurlError::HashMismatch {
+                    path: artifact.path.clone(),
+                    expected: artifact.sha256.clone(),
+                    actual: actual_hash,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+
+        Ok(())
+    }
+}
+
+pub fn compute_sha256(path: &Path) -> Result<String> {
+    let mut file = File::open(path)?;
+    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
+    let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
+
+    loop {
+        let count = file.read(&mut buffer)?;
+        if count == 0 {
+            break;
+        }
+        hasher.update(&buffer[..count]);
+    }
+
+    Ok(hex_encode(hasher.finalize()))
+}
+
+pub fn synthesize_manifest(run_dir: &Path) -> Result<Manifest> {
+    let run_id = run_dir
+        .file_name()
+        .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
+        .unwrap_or("RUN_UNKNOWN")
+        .to_string();
+
+    let mut artifacts = Vec::new();
+    collect_artifacts_recursively(run_dir, run_dir, &mut artifacts)?;
+
+    let mut scenarios = Vec::new();
+    for art in &artifacts {
+        if art.path.ends_with(".hurl") {
+            let full_path = run_dir.join(&art.path);
+            let name = full_path
+                .file_stem()
+                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())
+                .unwrap_or("scenario")
+                .to_string();
+            scenarios.push(ManifestScenario {
+                file: art.path.clone(),
+                name,
+                entry_count: None,
+            });
+        }
+    }
+
+    let mut phases = Vec::new();
+    let phases_tsv = run_dir.join("phases.tsv");
+    if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&phases_tsv) {
+        for line in content.lines() {
+            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split('\t').collect();
+            if parts.len() >= 2 {
+                let name = parts[0].to_string();
+                let exit_code = parts[1].parse::<i32>().ok();
+                let start_time = parts.get(2).map(|s| s.to_string());
+                let end_time = parts.get(3).map(|s| s.to_string());
+                let log_path = parts.get(4).map(|s| s.to_string());
+                phases.push(ManifestPhase {
+                    name,
+                    exit_code,
+                    start_time,
+                    end_time,
+                    log_path,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if phases.is_empty() {
+        phases.push(ManifestPhase {
+            name: "functional".to_string(),
+            exit_code: Some(0),
+            start_time: None,
+            end_time: None,
+            log_path: Some("functional-loan-import.err".to_string()),
+        });
+    }
+
+    let mut tools = HashMap::new();
+    tools.insert(
+        "tracehurl".to_string(),
+        env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
+    );
+
+    Ok(Manifest {
+        schema_version: 1,
+        run_id,
+        started_at: None,
+        finished_at: None,
+        tools,
+        phases,
+        scenarios,
+        artifacts,
+        variables: HashMap::new(),
+        redaction: Some(ManifestRedaction::default()),
+        live: None,
+    })
+}
+
+fn collect_artifacts_recursively(
+    base_dir: &Path,
+    current_dir: &Path,
+    artifacts: &mut Vec<ManifestArtifact>,
+) -> Result<()> {
+    if !current_dir.is_dir() {
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+
+    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(current_dir)? {
+        let entry = entry?;
+        let path = entry.path();
+        let file_name = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).unwrap_or("");
+
+        if file_name.starts_with('.') || file_name == "manifest.json" {
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        if path.is_dir() {
+            collect_artifacts_recursively(base_dir, &path, artifacts)?;
+        } else if path.is_file() {
+            let rel_path = path
+                .strip_prefix(base_dir)
+                .map_err(|e| TraceHurlError::ValidationFailed(e.to_string()))?
+                .to_string_lossy()
+                .to_string();
+
+            let metadata = entry.metadata()?;
+            let size_bytes = metadata.len();
+            let sha256 = compute_sha256(&path)?;
+
+            let (artifact_type, sensitivity) = classify_artifact(&rel_path);
+
+            artifacts.push(ManifestArtifact {
+                path: rel_path,
+                artifact_type,
+                size_bytes,
+                sha256,
+                sensitivity,
+            });
+        }
+    }
+
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+fn classify_artifact(path: &str) -> (String, SensitivityClass) {
+    if path.ends_with(".json") {
+        if path.contains("payload") {
+            ("payload".to_string(), SensitivityClass::Sensitive)
+        } else {
+            ("json-report".to_string(), SensitivityClass::Internal)
+        }
+    } else if path.ends_with(".hurl") {
+        ("hurl-scenario".to_string(), SensitivityClass::Internal)
+    } else if path.ends_with(".err") || path.ends_with(".log") {
+        ("log".to_string(), SensitivityClass::Sensitive)
+    } else if path.ends_with(".html") {
+        ("html-report".to_string(), SensitivityClass::Internal)
+    } else {
+        ("raw".to_string(), SensitivityClass::Internal)
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,149 @@
+use regex::Regex;
+use std::collections::HashSet;
+use std::sync::LazyLock;
+
+static TOKEN_PATTERN: LazyLock<Regex> = LazyLock::new(|| {
+    Regex::new(r"(?i)(eyJ[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,}\.[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{10,})").unwrap()
+});
+
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct RedactionConfig {
+    pub headers: HashSet<String>,
+    pub query_params: HashSet<String>,
+    pub json_keys: HashSet<String>,
+}
+
+impl Default for RedactionConfig {
+    fn default() -> Self {
+        let mut headers = HashSet::new();
+        headers.insert("authorization".to_string());
+        headers.insert("cookie".to_string());
+        headers.insert("set-cookie".to_string());
+        headers.insert("x-zeta-authtoken".to_string());
+        headers.insert("x-api-key".to_string());
+        headers.insert("x-auth-token".to_string());
+
+        let mut query_params = HashSet::new();
+        query_params.insert("token".to_string());
+        query_params.insert("access_token".to_string());
+        query_params.insert("secret".to_string());
+        query_params.insert("key".to_string());
+        query_params.insert("api_key".to_string());
+        query_params.insert("auth".to_string());
+        query_params.insert("password".to_string());
+
+        let mut json_keys = HashSet::new();
+        json_keys.insert("token".to_string());
+        json_keys.insert("accessToken".to_string());
+        json_keys.insert("password".to_string());
+        json_keys.insert("secret".to_string());
+
+        Self {
+            headers,
+            query_params,
+            json_keys,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+pub struct Redactor {
+    config: RedactionConfig,
+}
+
+impl Redactor {
+    pub fn new(config: RedactionConfig) -> Self {
+        Self { config }
+    }
+
+    pub fn redact_header_value(&self, header_name: &str, value: &str) -> String {
+        let lower = header_name.to_ascii_lowercase();
+        if self.config.headers.contains(&lower) {
+            if value.to_ascii_lowercase().starts_with("bearer ") {
+                "Bearer [REDACTED]".to_string()
+            } else {
+                "[REDACTED]".to_string()
+            }
+        } else {
+            self.redact_text(value)
+        }
+    }
+
+    pub fn redact_url(&self, url: &str) -> String {
+        let parts: Vec<&str> = url.splitn(2, '?').collect();
+        if parts.len() < 2 {
+            return self.redact_text(url);
+        }
+
+        let base = parts[0];
+        let query = parts[1];
+        let new_query: Vec<String> = query
+            .split('&')
+            .map(|param| {
+                let kv: Vec<&str> = param.splitn(2, '=').collect();
+                if kv.len() == 2 {
+                    let key = kv[0];
+                    if self.config.query_params.contains(&key.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
+                        format!("{}=[REDACTED]", key)
+                    } else {
+                        param.to_string()
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    param.to_string()
+                }
+            })
+            .collect();
+
+        format!("{}?{}", base, new_query.join("&"))
+    }
+
+    pub fn redact_text(&self, text: &str) -> String {
+        TOKEN_PATTERN
+            .replace_all(text, "[REDACTED_JWT]")
+            .to_string()
+    }
+
+    pub fn redact_curl_cmd(&self, cmd: &str) -> String {
+        let without_jwt = self.redact_text(cmd);
+        let header_re =

+        assert_eq!(redacted, "Bearer [REDACTED]");

+    #[test]

+use crate::error::Result;
+use crate::model::Run;
+use std::fs::File;
+use std::io::Write;
+use std::path::Path;
+
+const TEMPLATE_HTML: &str = include_str!("template.html");
+
+pub fn render_report_to_file(run: &Run, output_path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
+    let html = render_report_html(run)?;
+    if let Some(parent) = output_path.parent() {
+        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
+    }
+    let mut file = File::create(output_path)?;
+    file.write_all(html.as_bytes())?;
+    Ok(())
+}
+
+pub fn render_report_html(run: &Run) -> Result<String> {
+    let run_json = serde_json::to_string(run)?;
+    let escaped_run_json = run_json.replace("</script>", "<\\/script>");
+
+    let (overall_dot_class, overall_badge_class) = if run.summary.overall_status == "PASSED" {
+        (
+            "bg-secondary",
+            "bg-secondary/15 border border-secondary/40 text-secondary glow-green",
+        )
+    } else if run.summary.overall_status == "BLOCKED" {
+        (
+            "bg-amber-400",
+            "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30",
+        )
+    } else {
+        (
+            "bg-error",
+            "bg-error-container/20 border border-error/50 text-error glow-rose",
+        )
+    };
+
+    let html = TEMPLATE_HTML
+        .replace("__RUN_ID__", &run.run_id)
+        .replace("__VERSION__", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"))
+        .replace("__OVERALL_STATUS__", &run.summary.overall_status)
+        .replace("__OVERALL_DOT_CLASS__", overall_dot_class)
+        .replace("__OVERALL_BADGE_CLASS__", overall_badge_class)
+        .replace("__RUN_DATA_JSON__", &escaped_run_json);
+
+    Ok(html)
+}

+use std::path::Path;
+use tempfile::tempdir;
+use tracehurl::diff::diff_json;
+use tracehurl::ingest::ingest_run_directory;
+use tracehurl::manifest::{ManifestArtifact, synthesize_manifest};
+use tracehurl::model::*;
+use tracehurl::redaction::{RedactionConfig, Redactor};
+use tracehurl::render::render_report_to_file;
+
+fn get_test_run_dir() -> &'static Path {
+    Path::new(".verify/fixtures/sample_run")
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_ingest_and_render_real_artifacts() {
+    let run_dir = get_test_run_dir();
+    if !run_dir.exists() {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let run = ingest_run_directory(run_dir).expect("Ingestion must succeed");
+    assert_eq!(run.run_id, "TRACEHURL_SAMPLE_001");
+    assert_eq!(run.summary.overall_status, "FAILED");
+    assert_eq!(run.summary.total_entries, 4);
+
+    let temp = tempdir().expect("tempdir");
+    let html_path = temp.path().join("report.html");
+    render_report_to_file(&run, &html_path).expect("Render must succeed");
+
+    assert!(html_path.exists());
+    let html_content = std::fs::read_to_string(&html_path).expect("Read html");
+    assert!(html_content.contains("TraceHurl"));
+    assert!(html_content.contains("TRACEHURL_SAMPLE_001"));
+
+    // Redaction check: ensure Bearer token is never leaked in the generated HTML
+    assert!(!html_content.contains("secret-admin-token"));
+}

+#[test]
+fn test_manifest_validation_and_integrity() {
+    let run_dir = get_test_run_dir();
+    if !run_dir.exists() {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let manifest = synthesize_manifest(run_dir).expect("Synthesize manifest");
+    assert!(!manifest.artifacts.is_empty());
+    assert!(manifest.validate_artifacts(run_dir).is_ok());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_path_traversal_detection() {
+    let temp = tempdir().expect("tempdir");
+    let mut manifest = synthesize_manifest(temp.path()).expect("Synthesize manifest");
+
+    manifest.artifacts.push(ManifestArtifact {
+        path: "../../../etc/passwd".to_string(),
+        artifact_type: "raw".to_string(),
+        size_bytes: 10,
+        sha256: "0000".to_string(),
+        sensitivity: SensitivityClass::Secret,
+    });
+
+    let res = manifest.validate_artifacts(temp.path());
+    assert!(res.is_err());
+    let err = res.unwrap_err().to_string();
+    assert!(err.contains("escapes run directory"));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn test_json_diff_deep_nested_and_keys() {
+    let expected = r#"{"user": {"name": "Alice", "role": "admin", "limits": [10, 20]}}"#;
+    let actual = r#"{"user": {"name": "Alice", "role": "user", "limits": [10, 30, 40]}}"#;
+
+    let diffs = diff_json(expected, actual, ProvenanceOrigin::Recorded).expect("Diff");
+    assert_eq!(diffs.len(), 3);
+
+    let role_diff = diffs.iter().find(|d| d.path == "/user/role").unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(role_diff.diff_type, "Changed");
+    assert_eq!(role_diff.expected.as_deref(), Some("\"admin\""));
+    assert_eq!(role_diff.actual.as_deref(), Some("\"user\""));
+
+    let arr_change = diffs.iter().find(|d| d.path == "/user/limits/1").unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(arr_change.diff_type, "Changed");
+
+    let arr_add = diffs.iter().find(|d| d.path == "/user/limits/2").unwrap();
+    assert_eq!(arr_add.diff_type, "Added");
+}

+#[test]
+fn test_redaction_strictness() {
+    let redactor = Redactor::new(RedactionConfig::default());
+
+    let header_val = "Bearer secret-token-12345";
+    assert_eq!(
+        redactor.redact_header_value("authorization", header_val),
+        "Bearer [REDACTED]"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        redactor.redact_header_value("X-Zeta-AuthToken", "custom-token-xyz"),
+        "[REDACTED]"
+    );
+    assert_eq!(
+        redactor.redact_header_value("Cookie", "session=abcdef; user=admin"),
+        "[REDACTED]"
+    );
+
+    let url = "https://example.com/api/v1?token=jwt123&safe=public";
+    assert_eq!(
+        redactor.redact_url(url),
+        "https://example.com/api/v1?token=[REDACTED]&safe=public"
+    );
+}
